scope: Independent fresh long-audit processes reproduce64 screen cases per arm using the same Game/controller identities. Reported producer Game hashes, all23 and outcomes match; no raw final-state payload reconstruction claim. Diagnostics cover every win flip in both directions plus each per-policy worst adverse metric and unknown-coverage change. Observed costs/food facts are not a complete causal explanation of later endings.

intake.scope: Instrumented meals since startedDay. Cultivated fractions only; unclassified is not proof of non-garden food. Assistance means applied growth/yield on that crop cycle, not current ability ownership.

costs.scope: Observed net reserve debits before clock work, NPC hunger equivalents at 25 kcal/point, nominal seeds, requested clock ticks and actual elapsed ticks. A dawn may discard clock overshoot; the two tick counts are distinct. Excludes normal metabolism and unpriced duty opportunity costs.
